name: Bakhoor incense
where: Souq Waqif perfume and incense shops
about: Bakhoor is a traditional Gulf incense made from wood chips and fragrant oils. It is burned at home and offered to guests, so it is a common sight in Qatari homes and shops.
tip: Ask to smell several blends before you buy. Buy a small amount, and skip the charcoal and lighters sold alongside it.

name: Al Sadu woven pouch
about: Al Sadu is a traditional weaving style of Bedouin communities in Qatar and the wider Gulf. Its geometric patterns are rooted in desert life and local heritage.
tip: Check that the piece is locally made before you pay. Ask the seller where it was woven.
